types_note: games/hour at the actor settings. Measured Nov 11 from shard play times: c8a.16xlarge 18.0 s per 256-game shard (51k/h, 802/h/core; 46k/h on Nov 10 with the endgame branch on); m8a.48xlarge 23.6 s per 768-game shard (117k/h, 611/h/core: 24% slower per core than the 16xlarge). Zen 4 16xlarge 33k/h measured Nov 10 (scaled to 35k for the shorter games). 24xlarge interpolated; metals assumed equal to the 48xlarge until measured. Graviton (c8g/m8g = Graviton 4, c7g/m7g = Graviton 3; image built for neoverse-v1) added Nov 11 08:20 as guesses: 16xlarge 45k (G4) / 33k (G3) games/h; correct from the shard logs once one has played. Graviton MEASURED Nov 11 09:40: c8g.16xlarge 60 s per 256-game shard = 15k games/h (3.3x slower than c8a.16xlarge: the engine's kernels are AVX2-tuned, the aarch64 build uses plain loops; image built for neoverse-v1). At $0.7-1.0/h that is $4.7-6.6 per 100k games, above the cap, so Graviton is effectively excluded. Nov 11 20:15 (evening capacity crunch, one box left): added r8a (= m8a cores, 50k/70k), r7a (= m7a, 35k) and Intel c7i/r7i/m7i.16xlarge at a GUESSED 30k (Sapphire Rapids, AVX2 kernels; measure from the actor logs when one runs) for more capacity pools.
arm_game_cost_note: games of this arm per reference game of the `types` table (measured on on1: 18 s per 256-game shard on c8a.16xlarge). on2 (structure block + 4 settlement forks): 40 s/shard = 2.2; on3 (+ relation block, 4072 inputs): ~52 s/shard = 2.9. Shares (`arms`, unit 33k) are then in the arm's own games/h; $/100k and the cap stay in reference units. on5 (+ award/port block, 4335 inputs): 3.0 guessed from on3; measure from shard play times.
